hooks.name: Backend Module Integrity Check
hooks.description: When a new Python file is created in the backend, verify it follows the layered architecture and has proper typing.

action.prompt:
A new backend Python file was created. Verify architecture integrity:

LAYER PLACEMENT:
- Endpoints go in app/api/v1/endpoints/ and ONLY call services.
- Services go in app/modules/<name>/service.py and call repositories/storage/queue.
- Repositories go in app/repositories/ and are the ONLY persistence layer.
- Workers go in app/workers/ and are lifespan-managed.

CODE QUALITY:
- All functions have full type annotations (params + return type).
- Uses 'from app.xxx' absolute imports (not relative).
- Private helpers prefixed with '_'.
- No os.getenv() calls outside core/config.py.
- No direct Firestore/storage client imports outside repositories.

ERROR HANDLING:
- Raises ApiError with domain-specific code for expected failures.
- Never returns None from a public function without documenting why.

If it's a test file (tests/**), only check naming (test_*.py) and that it uses pytest fixtures.
Approve if compliant, flag specific violations if not.
